Hinter unserem „wir“ steht dabei ein Kollektiv aus engagierten Persönlichkeiten, was vielseitiger nicht sein könnte. Von ehemaligen Unternehmensberatern renommierter internationaler Unternehmen wie Ernst & Young oder Porsche Consulting über kreative Designprofis und Content-Experten bis zur TikTok Influencerin oder dem studierten Videografen – wir sind in unseren Fähigkeiten unterschiedlich, haben aber doch eine große Gemeinsamkeit: den Anspruch, uns kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und herausragende Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen. Wenn du Lust hast, in einem dynamischen und gleichermaßen etablierten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs Karriere zu machen und Teil eines jungen, ambitionierten und freundschaftlichen Teams zu werden, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Aufgaben Dein Part in unserem Team. Tätigkeiten. So etwas wie einen typischen Arbeitstag gibt es bei uns nicht. Wir entwickeln uns als Unternehmen stets weiter und erwarten dies auch von dir. jobs.title: Community Lead & Talent Acquisition Advisor - DACH
jobs.description: Hi, I’m Kayla :) I lead global community activation within Partnerships at Ashby . Before joining a year ago, I spent 15 years in TA and was an Ashby customer. I made the move out of TA into this role, and nothing I’d learned has gone to waste. If anything, I’ve learnt even more from the community. It’s genuinely one of the most rewarding and fun roles I’ve had, and as I step into a leadership role, I’m on the hunt for someone to take over the work in EMEA and evolve it further. We’re hiring an experienced TA Expert & Community Lead to grow one of our most successful GTM experiments: a high-touch, customer-led approach to growth. The model is already working across EMEA, built on curated events, product education and early community activation. We already work with some well-known teams in the region, and we’ve recently announced an EMEA data centre. We want to invest properly in the community there, and we know that needs to be led by someone local. Someone who knows the market, speaks the language and understands how TA teams in the region actually work. You’ll own the DACH community end to end, from customer breakfasts and curated experiences to enablement sessions and product demos. This role suits someone who has worked with Ashby All-in-One, has a solid background in TA, and cares about tools, process, hospitality and community building. It also works well for TA people who still love the work but want to use what they know somewhere new. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Product Marketing, own a region end-to-end, and see how community connects to pipeline and retention. A quick summary on travel, since it’s usually the first question and we know it means time away from home: you’ll have events in Germany regularly, plus travel to another DACH (or wider EMEA) country every month, usually for around four days. There is flex, though. I’m a mum of three, and in this role, I’ve been able to stay home and take meaningful time off during every school holiday.
